answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the zephyr of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the reef re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the cedar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
